The fixed circuit ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The job ID is 01a15f16-e924-778a-a663-f2cfba6afa51 and it completed. The counts were 00: 49 and 11: 51. That is the expected Bell pattern. The mock reported 0.0 estimated credits.

The original circuit had two bugs.
1. QB25 does not exist on Garnet. Garnet has 20 qubits, QB1 to QB20. I swapped QB25 for QB2. In the architecture, QB2 is a direct CZ neighbor of QB1 through the locus [QB2, QB1].
2. cx is not a native IQM gate. The native two-qubit gate on Garnet is cz. I built the CNOT from native gates. The circuit applies prx(pi/2, pi/2) on QB2, which is Ry(pi/2). Then it applies cz on [QB2, QB1]. Then it applies prx(pi/2, -pi/2) on QB2, which is Ry(-pi/2).

The first prx on QB1 stays as it was. It is Ry(pi/2), and it puts QB1 into superposition. The measure step now uses locus [QB1, QB2] with key "m". The fixed JSON is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-20/scratch/bell_fixed.json.

The mock returns random results, so these counts do not prove the circuit is correct. The 00/11 split does match a Bell pair. No real QPU job was submitted.
